violations.text: Raw animal foods such as raw hamburgers were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as cooked beef in the 2 door lowboy reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment to wash, rinse and sanitize all bar ware in 3 bay sink at bar and/or dishmachine in kitchen. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Foods in the following areas were out of temperature: -grill cooler (foods observed between 47-53 degrees Fahrenheit, ambient of unit was 45-48 degrees Fahrenheit) -top rail of prep unit 1 and 2 on the line (foods observed between 44-53 degrees Fahrenheit, ambient of top rail 1 and 2 respectively were 49 and 35 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and time temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Birria and Birria Consommé were observed held past 7 days. Foods were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets at server station 2 door lowboy were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/16/2026

The grill cooler and prep unit 1 on the cookline were not cold enough to maintain temperature for TCS/PHF foods. Units were taken out of service to hold foods that require refrigeration for food safety. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025

Food contact surfaces of the upstairs banquet kitchen ice machine were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was voluntarily disposed of; ice machine to be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized prior to use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the upstairs banquet dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. All dishes to be sanitized in 3 bay sink or in the downstairs dishwashing machine. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025
Several prepared foods were observed stored beyond 7 days in the walk-in cooler. Foods were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of various equipment near cookline, caulking by prerinse spray hose in ware-washing area and glasswasher at bar (exterior sides of machine) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2025

The condensate from the AC unit in upstairs banquet kitchen is positioned to drain in 3 bay sink basins. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain in a proper manner. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2025

The floor landing directly under cookline equipment is in poor repair. Material is cement, which is not durable, easily cleanable, or non-absorbent. The materials for indoor floors must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/29/2024

An employee was observed washing their hands at the food prep sink. Food employees shall clean their hands in a designated hand-washing sink and not in a food preparation, mop, or ware-washing sink. -Designated sink for handwashing only reviewed. -Staff washed their hands at the hand-washing sink during this inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/28/2023

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the ware-washing area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. -Staff provided hand soap during this inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/28/2023

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with food residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. -Staff washed, rinsed, and sanitized the can opener and slicer during this inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/28/2023

The non-food contact surfaces of the areas underneath the cook line (fryolators, ovens, stove top) have a heavy accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. The non-food contact surfaces shall be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent buildup of residue. New Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2023

The floors in the cook line are constructed of cement which is not durable, easily cleanable, or non-absorbent. The materials for indoor floors must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. -Floors shall be smooth, durable, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 02/29/2024
